# Translation: Mexican Notarial Power of Attorney, Public Deed No. 14,827, excerpt (ES → EN)

## Register & audience analysis
This is a Mexican notarial instrument (*escritura pública*) granting a general power of attorney. It uses formal civil-law notarial language. The reader is a compliance or legal officer at a US bank checking who may sign. The translation is literal and keeps the deed's structure, capitalization and long-form numbers so it can be checked line by line against the original. Civil-law terms of art keep the Spanish term in italics with an English gloss the first time they appear, so a US common-law reader doesn't assume they match US concepts exactly.

## Translation

He identifies himself with a voter identification card issued by the Instituto Nacional Electoral [National Electoral Institute], elector key RMVGJN85031509H701. He states that he has the legal capacity to contract and bind himself, and hereby grants a *PODER GENERAL AMPLÍSIMO* [GENERAL POWER OF ATTORNEY OF THE BROADEST SCOPE] for lawsuits and collections, acts of administration, and acts of ownership, in favor of Mrs. MARÍA ELENA TORRES NÚÑEZ, under the terms of article two thousand five hundred fifty-four of the Civil Code for the Federal District.

[Signature of the appearing party]
